scenarios.title: Phone sensor polling and cancellation
scenarios.reviewRequest: Check whether this polling code shuts down cleanly and handles cancellation.

plantedFindings.description: stop() does not clear the active polling interval or reset the timer state.
The AbortSignal is checked after the sensor read but is never passed into readTemperature, so an in-flight read cannot be cancelled.

scenarios.title: Local model client failure recovery
scenarios.reviewRequest: Review how this client behaves when requests keep failing and whether useful failure information survives.

plantedFindings.description: Non-abort failures retry forever with no attempt limit.
The catch path replaces the original failure details with a generic warning before retrying.

scenarios.title: External app trust boundary
scenarios.reviewRequest: Could anything coming from another app make us read something we should not, or expose information we meant to keep private?

plantedFindings.description: An untrusted relative path is joined directly to the allowed root and can escape it with parent-directory segments.
The Authorization header containing the API key is written to debug logs.

scenarios.title: Mixed reliability and trust-boundary request
scenarios.reviewRequest: Check whether a slow remote configuration can hang us and whether a user-chosen local filename can escape its intended directory.

plantedFindings.description: The remote fetch has no timeout or cancellation path.
The user-selected filename is joined directly to baseDir without proving the resolved path stays inside the allowed directory.

scenarios.title: Clean asynchronous client control
scenarios.reviewRequest: Check whether this request handles cancellation, timeouts, and failed responses cleanly.
